threat_event: CUI attached to commercial ERP orders or shared in the commercial collaboration tenant is exposed
threat_source: External attacker or SaaS vendor breach; staff error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,300 CUI files in ERP attachments and 900 in the commercial tenant; no DLP on CUI markings
treatment_plan: Purge; attachment block on DoD orders; DLP; prime exchange in the government-community tenant

threat_event: An attacker moves from the DC-6 corporate network into the IC-2 lab network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Route from the IC-2 lab to a corporate VLAN for a label printer
existing_controls: Lab firewall; EDR on lab workstations
treatment_plan: Move the printer inside the lab; remove the route

threat_event: Devices with tampered firmware are configured and shipped to a DoD installation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware checks at integration centers rely on OEM hashes that a compromised supplier can spoof if images are supplied through the supplier
existing_controls: Firmware hash checks against OEM portals; authorized sources only
treatment_plan: Signature verification from OEM sources only; serial provenance for every integration job

threat_event: Counterfeit products bought from brokers are sold to resellers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 61 of 180 brokers unassessed; buyers can choose brokers for commercial stock
treatment_plan: Broker assessments; approval workflow; serial validation
owner: IT Distribution vice president of purchasing

threat_event: A SKU without a manufacturer of record turns out to be covered equipment and ships on a federal order
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,900 SKUs without manufacturer of record
existing_controls: Hard block on federal orders for known covered manufacturers
treatment_plan: Make manufacturer of record mandatory; review the 1,900 SKUs

threat_event: A compromised supplier mailbox redirects a large payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplier mailboxes outside group control
treatment_plan: Bank changes only through the supplier portal with MFA

threat_event: The SPRS score posted in 2025 is shown to be unsupported for the full CUI environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 Basic Assessment excluded lab networks and CUI outside the FFE
treatment_plan: Re-assess the full scope and post a corrected score on counsel advice

threat_event: AI-001 automatic release sends purchase orders to unapproved sources or overbuys slow-moving stock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic release under $250,000 enabled before the Group AI Standard; no drift monitoring
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: drift monitoring, threshold review, buyer sampling
owner: IT Distribution vice president of purchasing

threat_event: Reseller portal accounts are taken over and used for fraudulent orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for reseller buyers
existing_controls: MFA for administrators; fraud rules on ship-to changes
treatment_plan: MFA required for all reseller users

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts FFE servers or lab workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab workstations connect to OEM firmware portals
existing_controls: EDR; snapshots every 4 hours; allow list
treatment_plan: FFE restore test; proxy-only access to OEM portals

threat_event: A sanitization failure leaks customer data from devices handled by Lifecycle Services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Verification sampling not documented on 2 of 5 lines
treatment_plan: Documented verification sampling on all lines

threat_event: The commercial ERP vendor is breached while it holds CUI attachments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No FedRAMP Moderate equivalency evidence
treatment_plan: Remove CUI from the ERP (ID-001) rather than seek equivalency

threat_event: A DIBNet report is late because certificate holders are unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two certificate holders in one location
treatment_plan: Two more certificate holders; tested sign-in

threat_event: DFARS 252.246-7008 terms are missing from broker purchase terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flowdown to brokers incomplete
treatment_plan: Amend broker terms

threat_event: An integration technician copies CUI for personal use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large CUI roster (about 420 people)
treatment_plan: Reduce roster to active job needs

threat_event: Refurbished Lifecycle stock with covered-manufacturer components is resold to resellers who sell to federal agencies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Section 889 block not applied to refurbished stock (3 SKUs found)
treatment_plan: Extend the block and warn resellers

threat_event: Vendor price files are altered in transit or at the supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Price files accepted from EDI without signature on 30% of partners
treatment_plan: Signed files for top 100 suppliers

threat_event: Visitors at IC-2 during the night dock shift are not escorted or logged
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Escort records missing in 2 of 6 sampled weeks
treatment_plan: Night-shift escort roster; visitor kiosk at the cage

threat_event: Receiving and buying staff miss signs of counterfeit or tampered products
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Anti-counterfeit training at 4 of 9 DCs only
treatment_plan: Role training at all DCs

threat_event: Inside sales staff are phished and their ERP sessions hijacked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing defeats non-phishing-resistant MFA
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for sales roles

threat_event: FCI in the forecasting feed is processed under terms without FAR 52.204-21 safeguards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DoD orders in the AI-001 training feed
treatment_plan: Remove DoD orders from the feed

threat_event: A hurricane closes IC-1 for more than a week
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IC-1 in Florida
treatment_plan: Joint scheduling plan with primes

threat_event: Competitors scrape reseller pricing from the portal API
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rate limits not per account
treatment_plan: Per-account rate limits

threat_event: Software license keys held for resale are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys stored in the ERP with broad read access
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Distribution security and compliance lead (2026-08-20): license keys are low value and OEM portals can revoke them; revisit if losses exceed $50,000 a year
owner: IT Distribution vice president of vendor programs
